body_lead: Your next cyber posts interview might be taken by AI:Maharashtra cyber becomes first govt department to use AI for recruitment, aims to cut delays and bias - Copy link Imagine this: you're applying for a job, and instead of facing a human panel, a bot pops up on your screen and starts the interview. It’s the future of recruitment, and Maharashtra Cyber Police is leading the charge. In a first-of-its-kind move in India, the Maharashtra Cyber Department is using artificial intelligence (AI) to conduct initial job interviews.
